They run SCADA/EMS stacks in isolated datacenters; any Redwood footprint must be installable inside the OT DMZ or a segregated management VLAN with strictly controlled jump-hosts.

Key contacts: Elena Rocha (CTO, elena.rocha@auric-guardian.gov) - technical signoff; Maj. Thomas Ridge (Security Lead, thomas.ridge@auric-guardian.gov) - controls/STIGs; Priya Menon (Procurement) - contract/AVL.

POC success criteria: install completes without egress; model inference meets latency targets on their GPU nodes; audit logs export to Splunk.
